summary: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its first-quarter 2026 financial results. The press release announces record revenues of $738.3 million (up 19.2% YoY) and net income of $35.6 million (up 84.5% YoY). It also references prior completed events: the February 2026 merger of subsidiaries Matrix IT and Magic Software (reverse triangular merger, stock consideration) and a January 2026 private placement by affiliate TSG that diluted Formula's ownership. This is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation filing; no new corporate action, catalyst, or event is disclosed.
